description_expanded: OverviewRenovated Condo-Public Beach-2 Minute Walk-Community Pool/Heated seasonallyThe SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Beach Access – Just steps away from Seagrove Beach & Eastern Lake! 8 Amenity Bands – Exclusive access to community perks! Two Tennis Courts – Enjoy a friendly match with family & friends! Two Community Pools – One pool heated seasonally for year-round enjoyment! Professionally Managed – 24/7 service for a seamless stay! Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your beach getaway! General Parking - 2 Passes Provided – Hassle-free parking for guests!Welcome to Cast A WavesIf you're looking for a vacation rental that offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and fun, Cast A Waves is the perfect choice for you. This beautifully renovated 3BR/2BA condo is just steps away from Seagrove Beach and Eastern Lake on Scenic 30A, making it an ideal spot for beach lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.Located in Beachside Villas, Cast A Waves offers a prime location that's just steps away from the beach access. The light and bright cheerful decor adds to the overall ambiance of the place and creates a soothing and relaxing atmosphere that's sure to make your vacation memorable.In addition to its convenient location, Cast A Waves is also centrally located between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, making it easy for you to explore the local attractions, restaurants, and shops. Whether you prefer biking, hiking, paddleboarding, canoeing, kayaking, or simply lounging on the sugary sand beaches, Cast A Waves is the perfect base from which to explore all that Scenic 30A has to offer.When you're not exploring the outdoors, Cast A Waves offers plenty of entertainment options to keep you and your family occupied. The well-equipped kitchen provides all the necessary amenities for cooking and preparing meals. The living room has a comfortable seating area where you can relax and watch TV or play board games with your family.Overall, Cast A Waves is the perfect vacation rental that offers you the best of both worlds - a luxurious and comfortable stay, combined with a prime location that provides easy access to the beach and other nearby attractions. Come spend your vacation at Cast A Waves and enjoy a vacation your family will never forget! This property offers 8 amenity bands. Children under 12 do not need a band. Guests will be charged $50.00 for lost amenity bands.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** Wireless Internet access.* Parking for 2 cars.**CALL FOR SNOWBIRD PRICING!**SLEEPING ARRAGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private bathroom with tub/shower comboGuest Bedroom 1: Queen sized bed, shared bathroomGuest Bedroom 2: Two full sized bed, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back. Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
